Build a batch of **dedicated game-server + gaming-VPS landing pages** for the Nxeon platform (Next.js App Router + Tailwind) at /opt/nxeon on THIS box — to capture buyer-intent search queries (Search Console shows impressions for "palworld vps", "gaming vps", etc. but no dedicated pages). These are money/SEO landing pages.

## Match the existing pattern
FIRST read the existing game/product landing pages to reuse their exact components, layout, and styling — e.g. `app/(marketing)/rust-server-hosting/page.tsx`, `minecraft-server-hosting/page.tsx`, `game-servers/page.tsx`, and the shared marketing primitives (PageHero, Section, pricing/plan components, FAQ, CtaBand). Clone that structure so the new pages look native. Use REAL, accurate game specs — there's keyword research with real RAM/port/version data at `/tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/keywords-games.md` (Palworld 16-32GB/port 8211, Valheim 4-8GB/2456-2458, ARK:SA 16GB, etc.) — use it for the specs + FAQ questions.

## Pages to build (route → target keyword)
Each at `app/(marketing)/<slug>/page.tsx`:
- `/palworld-server-hosting` — "Palworld server hosting" / "palworld vps"
- `/valheim-server-hosting` — "Valheim server hosting"
- `/ark-server-hosting` — "ARK: Survival Ascended server hosting"
- `/7-days-to-die-server-hosting` — "7 Days to Die server hosting"
- `/project-zomboid-server-hosting` — "Project Zomboid server hosting"
- `/v-rising-server-hosting` — "V Rising server hosting"
- `/enshrouded-server-hosting` — "Enshrouded server hosting"
- `/satisfactory-server-hosting` — "Satisfactory server hosting"
- `/terraria-server-hosting` — "Terraria server hosting"
- `/cs2-server-hosting` — "Counter-Strike 2 server hosting"
- `/garrys-mod-server-hosting` — "Garry's Mod server hosting"
- `/fivem-server-hosting` — "FiveM server hosting"
- `/gaming-vps` — "gaming VPS"

## Each page must have
- **SEO**: Metadata title (keyword-first, ≤60 chars), meta description (≤155, keyword + hook), canonical, OpenGraph — following how the existing landing pages set metadata.
- **H1** containing the exact keyword; a hero with a clear value prop for that game.
- Game-specific **specs** (recommended RAM/CPU per player count, from the research), **features** (instant setup, DDoS protection, NVMe, full file access, one-click — only claims Nxeon truthfully supports), a **plan/pricing** block (reuse the site's real plans/pricing component — don't invent prices), an **FAQ** (3-5 real "People Also Ask" questions from the research, e.g. "How much RAM for a Palworld server?"), and a **CTA**.
- **Internal links**: link to the matching blog post(s) for that game (they exist — e.g. /blog/how-to-set-up-a-palworld-dedicated-server-on-a-vps; verify slugs via the DB or existing-slugs), plus /game-servers and /pricing. This internal linking is important for ranking.
- Honest — no fabricated benchmarks/reviews/uptime numbers.

## Discovery + sitemap (important for SEO)
- Add all new routes to the **sitemap** (app/sitemap.ts — it's a curated list; add each new slug so Google can find them).
- Add a **"Game servers" grouping** linking these pages somewhere discoverable (the footer and/or the /game-servers page — add a grid/list of "Popular game servers" linking each new page). Internal links from existing pages help them get crawled + ranked.

## Finish
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean + `npm run build` pass (all new routes build). Commit (post-commit hook pushes GitHub). `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh` → verify HTTP 200 and that a couple new pages render (e.g. `curl -s http://51.79.162.96:8080/palworld-server-hosting | grep -i palworld`). Do NOT run promote-production — hand it back.
- Board: Nxeon board (`cmsavdblr0008hla4pygic72o`) — add a "Claude" comment to the "SEO" card (find it) noting the new game landing pages shipped for the high-impression queries.

Report: the list of pages created, that they're in the sitemap + linked from footer/game-servers, staging verification, and the prod deploy note (`bash scripts/promote-production.sh`).
